detail.longDescription: I love to fiddle with a logic game when I have some time to kill, but these days half the playtime is long non-skippable ads. The concept is simple, in the game you turn lasers and mirrors in order to reach all the crystals. It starts out simple, but later new mechanics are introduced, like splitters, portals and linked grids and at this point, random tapping is far from enough to succeed. If the early levels aren’t fun, try and skip ahead and see if you feel more of a challenge. Especially in Master I recently added a progression system with achievements and cosmetic skins, to make the player experience more rewarding and fun The levels are created procedurally with a generator and filtered by a set of rules and conditions, the levels are picked by an agent judge panel and then finally reviewed by me before being put into the game. This was honestly the most challenging part to get correct, and there’s still room for improvement. AI disclosure: the code is written with Claude Code, and I’ve used ChatGPT’s image generator for concept art. The music is created on ElevenLabs. Does it feel fun to play? Is it too easy or difficult? Does the progression and reward system actually feel rewarding? Hope you’ll give it a try. Enjoy!
